title: No benchmark source publishes a trustworthy timestamp, so freshness cannot be proven for any live run
expected: A benchmark source whose own as-of timestamp can be read, so freshness is provable
observed: RESOLVED SUBSTANTIALLY via the Robinhood Stock Token API (commit 8a122191ae8be6f16fb47b9353e4dcb070f57bbe). GET /rhj/prices/{symbol} is public and credential-free and publishes a per-quote generatedAt, which the Bitget MCP quote surface does not. Live read-only pre-flight on 2026-09-30T11:14Z: rNVDAUSDT -> NVDAUSDT -> NVDA; Robinhood bid 227.60 / ask 227.75 -> midpoint 227.675 USD; sourceAsOf 2026-09-30T11:14:15.103786657Z (provider generatedAt, verbatim); fetchedAt 2026-09-30T11:14:15.589Z (local); timestampType PROVIDER_GENERATED_QUOTE; freshness verified_fresh; ageMs 486 against a documented 15000ms cache window; isTradingHalt false; /rhj/assets confirms NVDA unique and ASSET_STATUS_ACTIVE. The benchmark gate now PASSES and the strategy path reached quantEvaluated=true with a live SELL_BASIS verdict, which had never happened before. The previous BLOCKED_EXTERNAL condition (no timestamped source exists) no longer holds. NOT CLOSED: see blocked_by and residual_closure.
root_cause: The available free-tier MCP equity surface provides prices without a per-instrument as-of timestamp. No candidate supplies an independently meaningful sourceAsOf.
closure_condition: A documented benchmark source publishes a parseable as-of timestamp
assessBenchmarkFreshness returns verified_fresh from that real source
A live run reaches Quant evaluation rather than blocking at the benchmark gate
regression_guard: packages/engine/test/robinhood-benchmark.test.ts — 31 tests across 7 named cases (valid generatedAt, missing, malformed, stale, fetchedAt distinct from sourceAsOf, invalid bid/ask, trading halt, symbol mapping, multiplier kept separate, shape drift, benchmark failure preventing Quant, valid benchmark reaching Quant) plus a dedicated boundary block of 7 tests covering the exact four-day boundary (4.00d stale, 3.99d fresh) and packet-level non-executability.
blocked_by: Robinhood ToS 2.3 automated-access interpretation is unresolved (GAP-019), and no evidence file or claim promotion has been reviewed for this adapter yet. Neither must be assumed.
resolution: Added packages/engine/src/integrations/robinhood/{schemas,benchmark,client}.ts. Strict Zod; fails closed on missing/malformed/stale generatedAt, non-positive or crossed bid/ask, symbol mismatch, trading halt, inactive asset, empty quotes, shape drift, HTTP and transport errors. sourceAsOf (provider generatedAt) and fetchedAt (local request time) are never merged and the request time is never substituted. currentMultiplier is carried as separate metadata with appliedToPrice=false because /rhj prices are RAW UNDERLYING-EQUITY values and applying a Robinhood multiplier to a Bitget rToken is unproven. Also fixed a real off-by-one: the freshness predicate was strict (ageMs > maxAgeMs) while BENCHMARK_MAX_AGE_MS is exactly 4 days, so a maximum-age quote was classified verified_fresh. The boundary is now inclusive (ageMs >= maxAgeMs is stale).
residual_closure: GAP-019 resolved with written terms clarification from Robinhood, or an operator decision that the intended use is permitted
Redacted evidence committed under foundry/evidence for the Robinhood benchmark read
Claim promotion reviewed and recorded; not performed by this gap closure

title: Robinhood ToS automated-access interpretation unresolved; terminology constraint on external-facing docs
expected: Documented provider terms that clearly permit the intended automated read-only benchmark polling for a hackathon submission
observed: Robinhood Chain Terms of Service (last updated 2026-08-24) are ambiguous for this use case. Section 2.3 Prohibited Use lists 'Network Abuse or Security Violations', which includes 'use of automated tools (such as bots, scrapers, or spiders)'. The same section prohibits 'bypassing technical or usage restrictions'. Against that, the Stock Token API is DOCUMENTED as public, read-only, rate-limited to 60 requests/second, with published per-endpoint cache windows, and is intended for developer consumption. The current adapter polls one symbol approximately 4 requests/minute against a 60 req/s limit and respects the 15s cache window, which reads as ordinary documented consumption rather than circumvention. This reading is NOT settled. NO WRITTEN AUTHORIZATION, CLARIFICATION, OR LEGAL REVIEW HAS BEEN OBTAINED.
root_cause: Provider terms do not distinguish documented rate-limited API consumption from prohibited automated tooling. Resolving this requires a provider position, not an engineering decision.
closure_condition: Written clarification from Robinhood, or a recorded operator legal decision that the intended read-only documented-API use is permitted
If permitted: poll rate and cache-window compliance are documented and evidenced
If not permitted: the Robinhood benchmark adapter is removed or replaced before any production use
blocked_by: Robinhood ToS 2.3 interpretation requires provider clarification or a legal decision

documentation_constraint.reference: Robinhood Chain Terms of Service 5.7(j) Unauthorized Product Terminology
documentation_constraint.rule: Stock Tokens must not be described, referred to, or marketed as 'tokenized stocks', 'tokenized equities', or similar characterizations. Approved external-facing terminology is 'Stock Tokens' or 'tokenized real-world assets such as Stock Tokens'.
documentation_constraint.current_violation: CORRECTED 2026-09-30 in the external-facing documentation: README.md, PRD.md, docs/product/PRODUCT_THESIS.md, docs/OPERATING_CHARTER.md, docs/AGENTS_CHARTER.md, docs/research/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md, docs/canonical/ASSUMPTIONS.md, foundry/assumptions.md and the GAP-016 ledger title now use 'tokenized real-world asset(s)' / 'Tokenized Real-World Assets'. Rewording deliberately avoided calling the Bitget instruments 'Stock Tokens': the Bitget rNVDA-style contracts are Reality rTokens, not Robinhood Stock Tokens, and section 5.7(j) governs Robinhood's own product. The two approved Robinhood phrasings are 'Stock Tokens' and 'tokenized real-world assets such as Stock Tokens'; the product-neutral second form was used for non-Robinhood instruments, and 'Stock Tokens' is reserved for the actual Robinhood surface.
documentation_constraint.scope: external-facing documentation only; internal code identifiers are unaffected
documentation_constraint.remaining_scope: Verify no future external-facing text reintroduces 'tokenized equities' when describing Robinhood Stock Tokens. Internal code identifiers (mapToVenueSymbol, REPO_SYMBOL, rNVDAUSDT) are unaffected and intentionally unchanged.
